6.364 rsInvalidDefaultRelationshipDuplicateRelatedDataset
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidDefaultRelationshipDuplicateRelatedDataset is a critical error that will occur when a
DefaultRelationship for a DataSet contains a RelatedDataSet that has already been specified in a
previous DefaultRelationship within the list of DefaultRelationships in a DataSet.
